lanes.title: Crew legality and roster fixes
lanes.areas: src/engine/crew/* (roster.ts, timeline.ts, rules.ts, check.ts, index.ts, tours.ts, buyBack.ts, control.ts, reasons.ts, dayPlan.ts), scripts/invariants.ts, fixtures/compatKit; no ui/ files

items.title: Crew tickets overlap: a home ticket lands after the next ticket out, or connects in 35 min (crew-ticketoverlap + core-2, major, CONFIRMED)
items.detail: Repros (confirmed in triage): `npx tsx scripts/invariants.ts save /home/user/work/v025/hunt/triage/mad-d196.json 2` gives ERROR crew-overlap for Davide Romano, duty 13 Sep 2027 09:00 starting before 09:40. `... save /home/user/work/v025/hunt/triage/s9-d379.json 2` gives ERROR crew-overlap for Carlos Diaz on 14 Mar 2028, 17:00 against 17:25. Fix: roster.ts sendHome (~801) `held` only sees tickets leaving from c.loc. Treat the earliest later ticket of the person, including one out of c.base, as a deadline: its std - deadheadCheckIn - CONNECT_MIN (75). If no seat home lands before that, ticket loc to that trip's destination, or drop and re-ticket the trip. Ticket placement in timeline.ts must require later dep >= arr + 75 + check-in, and drop a 'back to the set' ticket when another set already holds the person. Tests: a unit test with a crafted state. Both dumps must give 0 crew-overlap errors.

items.title: Re-timed 'Tour out' ticket breaks the 168 h recovery rule and flies a CC out and straight back (major, CONFIRMED)
items.detail: `npx tsx scripts/acmi-bot.ts 11 --from=/home/user/work/v025/hunt/triage/s11-d88.json --on=4 --inv --routes --base=MLA` gives ERROR recovery for Rachel Zammit (176:05 since 23 May 10:00) and warn sby-rest for Wojcik (6:00). Whatever re-times a set's tour-out ticket after a change request (events.ts accept, then crew re-plan) must run the rules.ts:771 recovery check (RECOVERY_KEEP) on the new ticket. Refuse the move, or place a 36 h recovery first, and never move a ticket whose holder is sent home again within 48 h. Test: the repro must give 0 recovery errors.

items.title: Zero-margin crew loses the whole crew over a 2-minute delay; V7892/93 cancelled for $30K (major)
items.detail: Hunter repro: /home/user/work/v025/hunt/ops/m42.json, using the h-ops scripts trace2.ts/v7892c.ts (V7892 NTE-PRG on 8 Sep 2027). guardDuty (roster.ts ~1887) has earlyHome for a ticket home. Add the mirror: when crew are short only of the rest before a positioning ticket OUT, rebook a later ticket (e.g. 12:00 to 13:00) that still makes the report, instead of taking them off. Also add a 30-60 min margin over minimum rest when the roster plans an airline ticket straight after a night duty. Test: a crafted duty plus ticket with a 2-min late arrival keeps its crew.

items.title: Invariants: fdp discretion false positive, compatKit settle, two money checks (core-6 + core-i3)
items.detail: scripts/invariants.ts ~383: raise an error only when the overrun known at the last sector's ATD is over 2 h/3 h (ORO.FTL.205(f)). Repro: `acmi-bot 23 --from=/home/user/work/v025/hunt/core/s23-d1013.json --on=5 --inv --routes --wide --base=SOF` reports a discretion of 2:03 that is legal. Add settle(g) to compatKit.play/playTo, so the v0.23.1 fixtures stop reporting orphans. Add the checks route.unearned == sum of sold unflown non-voided sectors, and factored paidToUs >= 0 with advance <= amount. Size S.

items.title: Far-base reserve hotel standby written after the fact never updates lastRecovery
items.detail: crew/index.ts reserveStoodBy (~330): call noteRecovery(c, from, g) before pushing the window. Repro: `acmi-bot.ts 7 365 --inv --routes --base=MLA` fails 'recovery gap <= 168 h' at 361 h, with CPT Lewandowska at ICN. Test: the noteRecovery call path in a unit test. Size S.

items.title: One Inbox message per set for 'goes home early' bursts, plain reason; buyBack day list wording
items.detail: roster.ts:383 posts one chiming message per crew member: 7 in one minute in the Malteser save on 3 Aug 2027 ('Block 28d 102:07 > 100:00...'). Instead, when an unread 'goes home early' message with the same set and g.now exists, add the name to it: 'Set 2 at RUH: 7 crew go home early: Caruana, Rossi, ...'. Write the reason in plain words ('Over 100 block hours in 28 days'). buyBack.ts:67 joins with ' and ': use 'A, B and C' and drop the repeated year in the same month. Merges ui-inbox-merge-bursts and immersion-early-home-spam. Test: one message for N releases at the same minute.

items.title: Loading an old save is not idempotent: day plan built only on the second load
items.detail: `scripts/hunt/oldplan.ts v08` (h-core) gives 0 of 81 crew with 'off' on the first load. In crew onLoad, run the day plan whenever any crew member lacks 'off', whatever the marker says. Run repairCutStandby after the load settles, so the first load reaches the fixed point. Test: on fixture v08, serialize(load(x)) equals serialize(load(serialize(load(x)))).

items.title: On-station strip shows a wrong set home date and day count
items.detail: tours.ts deploymentSets (~205): count only tickets to homeBase that leave from dep.base, or later than the set's first duty, and that are not guest-duty tickets. Start the day count at the set's first arrival. Malteser save: 'Set 3 at London ... home 1 Aug' should read 10 Aug. Size S.

items.title: Red crew-out-of-hours alarm stays 47 h though a free member of another set at the station could fly as a guest
items.detail: Repro: `acmi-bot.ts 11 130 --routes --base=VNO --alarms=out.txt --crewcheck`, VJ723 SGN-CGK on 4 Jul 2027. Dumps are in /home/user/work/v025/hunt/crew/vno-d124.json and vno-d126.json. check.ts otherTrip (~662-670) holds a tour member for the whole tour span. When re-crewing one seat for one duty, let the auto-roster try the free person as a GUEST for that duty only (the v0.23 guest path). Test from the vno-d124 dump state: the seat is filled before the gate. Size M.

items.title: Case charges list rent per BH, while the P&L charges the real (often owned) aircraft (major, code-confirmed)
items.detail: launch.ts:318/611 use aircraftCostBH(g, null, type) ($980-1,200/BH), while pnl.ts:86 uses the actual aircraft ($46-60/BH owned). One model: the case costs the average aircraftCostBH(g, id) over our aircraft of that type, falling back to list rent when we own none. The same applies to ideas and acmiResult. Repro: RIX seed 9 RIX-FRA case -$38K vs actual +$295K. Test: case aircraft cost equals the fleet-type average.

items.title: studyBase recomputed daily, so the Sales cabin quote and reopened cases show a different market (major, code-confirmed)

Have businessCaseX, businessCase, caseAdvice, stopoverCompare and cabin.ts read it. Add an onLoad repair that computes it once when missing (??=). Repro: RIX seed 9 RIX-FRA, base 372.9 at the case vs 1022.5 on sale. Test: the value stays stable after advancing 60 days.

Add an 'unruly' card modelled on medicalCard, with the purser named: 'Continue; police meet the aircraft' (report to authorityName(g)) or 'Divert and offload' (alternates(), handling cost, excused delay, half billed back to the passenger later through the ledger).
